items.title: Fintech Summit 2026
items.summary: The Fintech SummitThe Fintech Summit is Scotland’s largest annual gathering of financial technology leaders, and has established itself as the must-attend event for stakeholders in the sector.The conference will explore technological innovation across the industry, from developments in leading FS institutions, to the disruptive innovators within the challenger and start-up community that are reshaping the Financial Services market. The programme will consider the key shifts in regulation, investment, and technology, and discuss how they will impact the future evolution of the sector.The Summit is the official flagship event of the Scotland Fintech Festival, and is free to attend for delegates working for Financial Services and FinTech companies.
